components.description: Existing linked notice from src/components/AssessmentLimitations.tsx. Utilities expanded using node_modules/tailwindcss/theme.css; no extra hover treatment is declared in the source. Breakpoints above use that same theme, as applied by the methodology page and Header.
components.html:
This is a self-reflection tool, not therapy or a clinical assessment. It isn’t a substitute for professional mental health or relationship support.

Methodology & Limitations
components.css: .ds-assessment-limitations { border-radius: 0.75rem; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 80%); padding: 1.25rem; font-family: var(--font-raleway, Raleway), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.625; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--color-foreground, rgb(7, 7, 8)); } .ds-assessment-limitations p { margin: 0; } .ds-assessment-limitations a { display: inline-block; margin-top: 0.75rem; color: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-assessment-limitations a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 4px; }
